UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION FORM 10-K

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business is subject to significant competitive pressure from larger, better-capitalized rivals in the robotics and automation sector, and we may be unable to maintain our current pricing or market share.

We rely on a limited number of suppliers for critical components, and any disruption to that supply chain could materially harm our ability to manufacture and ship products on schedule.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue for fiscal year 2025 increased 25% year over year, driven by strong demand for our warehouse automation platform among mid-market logistics customers.

Operating expenses grew more slowly than revenue, resulting in improved operating margin compared with the prior fiscal year.

Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

We are exposed to foreign currency risk on sales denominated in euros and Japanese yen, which we do not currently hedge.

Interest rate risk on our variable-rate credit facility is limited given the facility's modest outstanding balance.

Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data

The consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes required by this Item are set forth beginning on page F-1 of this report.
